lines: Shmackle VR on Meta Quest · NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin

bio.location: Ho Chi Minh City · onsite Korea
bio.about: Built Shmackle VR, a multiplayer social sandbox on Meta Quest, and an NVIDIA Omniverse digital twin shown at AI Summit Tokyo 2024. Top 6 at Vietnam GameVerse 2024.

quotes.text: My git history is like my browser history: I force-push before anyone checks.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: I don't always pull out, but when I do, it's a pull request.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Merge conflict: two branches went in at the same time and nobody wanted to be on the bottom.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: She said "commit". I said "git add" first, foreplay matters.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Rebasing is just lying about your past with extra steps.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: My code is like my love life: full of exceptions nobody catches.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: I'm not saying the codebase is old, but its first commit message was a fax.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Senior dev move: write it dirty, squash it, and tell everyone it was clean the first time.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: I studied 4 years at university just to be a condom for Claude Code.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: The AI writes the code, I take the blame. Basically a surrogate dad for bugs.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Vibe coding: unprotected deploys and a lot of praying.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: I don't review AI code. I just wipe and hope.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Copilot finishes my sentences better than my ex ever did.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Prompt engineer: professional at begging a robot to go deeper.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: VR dev: the only job where I wear a headset all day and still can't see my own bugs.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: My frame rate is like my stamina: 90 on a good day, 30 in front of the client.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Shader got wet, now everything is shiny. Don't ask.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Multiplayer is just single-player with more people watching you fail.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Unity said "compiling scripts" and I aged into a senior dev.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: I added physics to the boobs before the gameplay. Priorities, said every indie dev ever.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Standup: fifteen people pretending they did something yesterday.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Pair programming: two people, one keyboard, zero dignity.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Code review is foreplay. Production is where you find out who's been faking it.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: My PM wants it hard, fast, and on Friday. That's not a feature, that's a fetish.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Hotfix in production at 3 a.m.: wrong hole, but it works.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Tech debt is like a hangover: you didn't think about it while you were doing it.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Kubernetes: fifty containers, all screwing each other, and somehow it's my fault.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: The client wanted it bigger. It's always bigger. They never ask for better.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Deploy on Friday and spend the weekend with your logs instead of your partner.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev

quotes.text: Documentation is like safe sex: everyone agrees it's important, nobody actually does it.
quotes.author: Bill The Dev
